answer_1.quote: We formulate the controlling text generation based on RST as a conditional text generation. The input consists of a binary RST tree, keyphrases, and their positions in the tree. ... The output is a token sequence x reflecting the inputs.
answer_1.outputs: token sequence x reflecting the inputs

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR (MTR) ... We report BLEU-4 (B-4), which evaluates the overlap of 4-grams, and ROUGE-L (R-L), which measures the longest common subsequence between the generated texts and reference texts. BERTscore (B-S) is used for evaluating semantic similarities. Fluency is evaluated through perplexity (PPL) ... Recall of discourse markers (DM) ... GRUEN assesses generated texts from following for perspectives: grammaticality, non-redundancy, focus, and coherence.
